file_id: Kajem Mondal @ Kajem Ali Mondal vs Unknown on 3 June, 2025

sentences.text: Kajem Mondal @ Kajem Ali Mondal vs Unknown on 3 June, 2025

In re: An application for bail under Section 483 of the
 Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 in
 connection with Domkal Women Police Station Case
 No.479 of 2023 dated 16-7-2023 under Sections
 376(3) of Ipc and Section 6 of the Pocso
 Act
 -And-

In the matter of : Kajem Mondal @ Kajem Ali Mondal
 .... Petitioner.
 Ms. Sonali Das
 Mr. Nobiul Islam
 Mr. B Islam
 ...
For the Petitioner.
Ms. Manisha Sharma
Mr. Asif Dewan
... For the State.

Mr. Aniket Mitra
 ...
For the de facto complainant.

2
1. 
It is said on behalf of the accused-petitioner that this petitioner is absolutely innocent and has/had no connection with the offence alleged.

It is further said that the evidence taking process has already been started and as such no purpose will be served by detaining this accused-petitioner behind the bar for the sake of custodial interrogation.

2. Learned advocate for the State raises objection by submitting that offence involved in this case is serious in nature and the victim is a 6-year old child and this accused- petitioner has allegedly committed rape upon her and if at this stage this accused-petitioner is enlarged on bail then there is every chance of tampering the evidence.
3. I have considered the materials on record.
Victim is a six- year old child and the allegation is that the accused-petitioner committed rape upon her.
The offence involved in this case is serious in nature.
Considering the gravity of the offence I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner bail.
